gap: Cmd/Ctrl+K, a completion path the contract names for the open card, does nothing there, and the Escape that follows throws away the typed title. SEED (clock Tue 2026-03-10 09:00 America/New_York, lists as recur-check, desktop 1200x800): things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Clean room',when:'today',repeat:{mode:'completion',every:1,unit:'day'}}], route #/today. STEPS: (1) double-click the row label; the card opens with the caret at the end of the title. (2) type ' and desk'. (3) press Cmd+K (Meta+K; Control+K behaves the same). (4) press Escape. EXPECTED: CONTRACT Repeating to-dos says 'every completion path from the card (its checkbox, More > Complete, Cmd/Ctrl+K) copies the title on screen into the next occurrence', and 'Completing an open repeating to-do creates exactly one next occurrence' through every completion path including Cmd/Ctrl+K. So after step 3 storage should be t1 [x] 'Clean room and desk' plus a next [ ] 'Clean room and desk' on 2026-03-11. The contract also says 'Escape in the title still restores the old one, unless completing or reopening from the card has already committed it', so step 4 should keep the typed title. ACTUAL (4/4 clean runs, 2 with Meta+K and 2 with Control+K, no page errors): after step 3 storage still holds 1 to-do, [ ] 'Clean room and desk' (saved as typed), not completed, with no next occurrence. After step 4 it is [ ] 'Clean room': the typed ' and desk' is gone and the to-do is still open. With the caret in the notes, Cmd+K also does nothing. CAUSE: view.js onKeydown returns early whenever a text field has focus (isText), detail.js has no Cmd/Ctrl+K handler, and the card always keeps focus in one of its text fields, because its mousedown handler stops focus from leaving them. So Cmd/Ctrl+K never completes from the open card. CONTROLS in the same script: after the same typing, the card's checkbox gives t1 [x] plus a next [ ], both 'Clean room and desk'. Cmd+K on a selected, closed row completes and spawns the next one.
